title: Skywatcher's government-funded UAP observation events, four and a half years without psionics

tellings.quote: So, in four of not for half a year there was no psionics in general. We have eight classes with this.

plain: From about 2020 to 2025, a speaker from Skywatcher, a startup that says it can call UFOs to appear, says the company ran sky-watching events paid for by the government. The events were meant to see UAP, the official term for unidentified objects in the sky. In a garbled passage the speaker tells Michels that for about four and a half years there was "no psionics," meaning no attempt to use the mind to draw the objects in, and mentions "eight classes" of something linked to it. The point seems to be that the sightings did not depend on mental methods.
